fact: On 28 October 2024 the National Security spokesperson said the biometric ID card and passport project was about 70% complete, to start in the second half of 2025, with fingerprint and photo data held by the Interior Ministry's central IT department and card production centralised at the Technical and Scientific Police.
title: تاريخ بدء العمل ببطاقة التعريف وجواز السفر البيومتريين
